<script module lang="ts">
  import { defineParticleMeta } from "$LIB$/registry/particle-metadata.js";

  export const meta = defineParticleMeta({
    components: ["radio-group", "segmented-control"],
    id: "p-radio-group-7",
    interactive: true,
    responsive: true,
    title: "Small segmented control built with a radio group",
  });
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import * as RadioGroup from "$UI$/radio-group/index.js";
  import {
    segmentedControlItemVariants,
    segmentedControlRootClassName,
  } from "$LIB$/segmented-control.js";

  const itemClassName = segmentedControlItemVariants({
    className: "grow",
    size: "sm",
    state: "checked",
  });
</script>

<RadioGroup.RadioGroupPrimitive
  aria-label="Billing period"
  class={segmentedControlRootClassName}
  value="monthly"
>
  <RadioGroup.RadioPrimitive.Root class={itemClassName} value="monthly">
    Monthly
  </RadioGroup.RadioPrimitive.Root>
  <RadioGroup.RadioPrimitive.Root class={itemClassName} value="yearly">
    Yearly
  </RadioGroup.RadioPrimitive.Root>
</RadioGroup.RadioGroupPrimitive>
